description: This file defines the DataGroupPermissionFilterParams class used for filtering data group permissions based on roles, entities, and other criteria in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: DataGroupPermissionFilterParams
classes.description: A class encapsulating parameters for filtering data group permissions, including roles, entities, and flags for API data and access restrictions.

methods.name: getUserRoles
methods.description: Returns the list of UserRole objects associated with the filter parameters.

methods.name: setUserRoles
methods.description: Sets the list of UserRole objects for the filter parameters.

methods.name: isWithApiDataGroups
methods.description: Checks if API data groups are included in the filter.

methods.name: setWithApiDataGroups
methods.description: Sets whether to include API data groups in the filter.

methods.name: isOnlyAccessible
methods.description: Indicates whether only accessible permissions are considered.

methods.name: setOnlyAccessible
methods.description: Sets whether to consider only accessible permissions.

methods.name: getRolesToExclude
methods.description: Returns roles that should be excluded from the filter.

methods.name: setRolesToExclude
methods.description: Sets roles to exclude from the filter.

methods.name: getRolesToInclude
methods.description: Returns roles that should be included in the filter.

methods.name: setRolesToInclude
methods.description: Sets roles to include in the filter.

methods.name: getEntities
methods.description: Returns entity identifiers associated with the filter.

methods.name: setEntities
methods.description: Sets entity identifiers for the filter.

methods.name: getDataGroups
methods.description: Returns data group identifiers included in the filter.

methods.name: setDataGroups
methods.description: Sets data group identifiers for the filter.

methods.name: isSelfPermissions
methods.description: Checks if self permissions are enabled.

methods.name: setSelfPermissions
methods.description: Enables or disables self permissions in the filter.
